#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run a small, reproducible design-search harness for the Jing-Zhang entry.

The harness is intentionally separate from the submission compiler.  It compares
three genuinely different spatial roots inside the same normalized reference
envelope, rejects geometry failures before preference scoring, and writes only
auditable state/results (never chain-of-thought).  The selected submission can
then cite the resulting receipts without pretending that an LLM is a simulator.

This is an internal design instrument.  Its reference envelope and programme
range are comparison controls, not official planning controls or parcel data.
"""

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Mass:
    id: str
    x: float
    y: float
    width: float
    depth: float
    height: float
    storeys: int
    layer: str = "support"
    angle: float = 0.0
    public_through_route: bool = False
    summer_only_shade: bool = False

    def polygon(self) -> Polygon:
        polygon = box(
            self.x - self.width / 2,
            self.y - self.depth / 2,
            self.x + self.width / 2,
            self.y + self.depth / 2,
        )
        return rotate(polygon, self.angle, origin=(self.x, self.y), use_radians=False) if self.angle else polygon


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Route:
    id: str
    start: tuple[float, float]
    end: tuple[float, float]
    kind: str = "public"
    operating_rule: str = "always"

    def line(self) -> LineString:
        return LineString([self.start, self.end])


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicRoom:
    id: str

    y: float

    depth: float
    kind: str

    def polygon(self) -> Polygon:

def canonical_json(value: Any) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def sha256_value(value: Any) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(value)).hexdigest()


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def canonical_feature_records(items: list[Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return feature records in semantic ID order for order-invariant hashes."""
    records = [asdict(item) for item in items]
    return sorted(records, key=lambda item: (str(item.get("id", "")), canonical_json(item)))

def shared_floor(offsets: dict[str, float] | None = None) -> Candidate:
    """Temporal/open-building root derived from the selected submission spec.

    ``offsets`` is a deliberately small rebind seam for deterministic harness
    probes.  It relocates complete prototype systems and their dependent routes;
    it never stretches completed polygons and is not an official parcel binder.
    """
    sys.path.insert(0, str(WORKSPACE / "tools"))
    try:
        import build_shared_floor as builder
    finally:
        sys.path.pop(0)

    resolved_offsets = dict(DEFAULT_SHARED_FLOOR_OFFSETS if offsets is None else offsets)
    if set(resolved_offsets) != set(DEFAULT_SHARED_FLOOR_OFFSETS):
        raise ValueError("shared-floor offsets must define proof, origin and exchange")
    if not all(isinstance(value, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(value) for value in resolved_offsets.values()):
        raise ValueError("shared-floor offsets must be finite numbers")
    masses: list[Mass] = []
    rooms: list[PublicRoom] = []
    routes: list[Route] = [Route("SF-COMMON", (-345, -108), (345, -108))]
    for key, proto in builder.PROTOTYPES.items():
        xoff = float(resolved_offsets[key])
        for element in proto["elements"]:
            masses.append(
                mass(
                    element["id"],
                    xoff + element["x"],
                    element["y"],
                    element["w"],
                    element["d"],
                    element["height"],
                    element["storeys"],
                    element["layer"],
                    float(element.get("angle", 0)),
                    bool(element.get("public_through_route", False)),
                    False,
                )
            )
        for index, (x, y, width, depth, name) in enumerate(proto["courts"], start=1):
            rooms.append(PublicRoom(f"SF-{key.upper()}-{index}", xoff + x + width / 2, y + depth / 2, width, depth, name))
        # Tree crowns are summer-only shade proxies: they are visible in the
        # production prototype plans, carry no GFA/footprint, and are excluded
        # from winter shadow so deciduous planting does not erase solar access.
        tree_diameter = float(proto.get("tree_canopy_diameter_m", 10))
        for index, (x, y) in enumerate(proto["trees"], start=1):
            masses.append(mass(f"TREE-{key.upper()}-{index}", xoff + x, y, tree_diameter, tree_diameter, 8, 0, "canopy", 0, True, True))
        for index, (start, end, kind) in enumerate(proto["routes"], start=1):
            routes.append(Route(f"SF-ROUTE-{key.upper()}-{index}", (xoff + start[0], start[1]), (xoff + end[0], end[1]), kind, "explicit-time-window" if kind != "public" else "always"))
    routes.extend(
        [
            Route("SF-COMMON-LINK-PROOF", (float(resolved_offsets["proof"]), -108), (float(resolved_offsets["proof"]), -66)),
            Route("SF-COMMON-LINK-ORIGIN", (float(resolved_offsets["origin"]), -108), (float(resolved_offsets["origin"]), -27)),
            Route("SF-COMMON-LINK-EXCHANGE", (float(resolved_offsets["exchange"]), -108), (float(resolved_offsets["exchange"]), 0)),
        ]
    )
    return Candidate(
        "C03-SHARED-FLOOR",
        "京张共地",
        "The Shared Floor",
        "Make public ground and long-life support the permanent civic asset while infill and AI equipment remain replaceable; court, cloister and hall test three non-identical architectural orders.",
        masses,
        routes,
        rooms,
        ["one-common-public-floor", "support-infill-separation", "three-non-identical-spatial-orders", "ai-removable"],
    )


GEOMETRY_AREA_TOLERANCE_SQM = 0.1


def pair_overlap_count(polygons: list[Polygon]) -> int:
    count = 0
    for index, first in enumerate(polygons):
        for second in polygons[index + 1 :]:
            if first.intersection(second).area > GEOMETRY_AREA_TOLERANCE_SQM:
                count += 1
    return count


def cast_shadow(poly: Polygon, height: float, altitude_deg: float) -> Polygon:
    """Noon proxy: sun due south, shadow cast north by z/tan(altitude)."""
    distance = height / math.tan(math.radians(altitude_deg))
    moved = translate(poly, yoff=distance)
    return unary_union([poly, moved]).convex_hull.difference(poly)


def route_connects_envelope(route: Route) -> bool:
    if route.kind != "public":
        return False
    line = route.line()
    minx, _, maxx, _ = ENVELOPE.bounds
    start_x, end_x = route.start[0], route.end[0]
    return min(start_x, end_x) <= minx + 8 and max(start_x, end_x) >= maxx - 8 and ENVELOPE.buffer(1e-6).covers(line)


def connected_route_components(routes: list[Route], tolerance: float = 0.05) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Return route-index components using geometric contact, not shared labels."""
    if not routes:
        return []
    lines = [item.line() for item in routes]
    unseen = set(range(len(routes)))
    components: list[list[int]] = []
    while unseen:
        seed = unseen.pop()
        component = {seed}
        frontier = [seed]
        while frontier:
            current = frontier.pop()
            neighbours = [index for index in unseen if lines[current].distance(lines[index]) <= tolerance]
            for index in neighbours:
                unseen.remove(index)
                component.add(index)
                frontier.append(index)
        components.append(sorted(component))
    return components


def evaluate(candidate: Candidate) -> dict[str, Any]:
    mass_polys = [item.polygon() for item in candidate.masses if item.layer != "canopy"]
    building_union = unary_union(mass_polys)
    public_union = unary_union([item.polygon() for item in candidate.public_rooms])
    solar_public_rooms = [item for item in candidate.public_rooms if "all-weather" not in item.kind]
    solar_public_union = unary_union([item.polygon() for item in solar_public_rooms]) if solar_public_rooms else Polygon()
    public_routes = [item for item in candidate.routes if item.kind == "public"]
    connecting_routes = [item for item in public_routes if route_connects_envelope(item)]
    route_components = connected_route_components(public_routes)
    public_route_union = unary_union([item.line() for item in public_routes]) if public_routes else LineString()
    unreachable_rooms = [
        item.id for item in candidate.public_rooms
        if item.polygon().distance(public_route_union) > 0.05
    ]
    all_feature_ids = [item.id for item in candidate.masses] + [item.id for item in candidate.routes] + [item.id for item in candidate.public_rooms]
    duplicate_feature_ids = sorted({ident for ident in all_feature_ids if all_feature_ids.count(ident) > 1})
    blocking_union = unary_union([item.polygon() for item in candidate.masses if not item.public_through_route])
    route_collisions = sum(1 for item in public_routes if item.line().buffer(1.5).intersection(blocking_union).area > GEOMETRY_AREA_TOLERANCE_SQM)
    outside_area = building_union.difference(ENVELOPE).area

    support_polys = [item.polygon() for item in candidate.masses if item.layer == "support"]
    infill_polys = [item.polygon() for item in candidate.masses if item.layer == "infill"]
    support_union = unary_union(support_polys) if support_polys else Polygon()
    infill_union = unary_union(infill_polys) if infill_polys else Polygon()
    support_infill_overlap = support_union.intersection(infill_union).area

    winter_shadows = unary_union([unary_union([item.polygon(), cast_shadow(item.polygon(), item.height, WINTER_ALTITUDE_DEG)]) for item in candidate.masses if not item.summer_only_shade])
    summer_shadows = unary_union([unary_union([item.polygon(), cast_shadow(item.polygon(), item.height, SUMMER_ALTITUDE_DEG)]) for item in candidate.masses])
    public_area = public_union.area
    solar_public_area = solar_public_union.area
    winter_sun_fraction = 1.0 if solar_public_area == 0 else max(0.0, 1.0 - solar_public_union.intersection(winter_shadows).area / solar_public_area)
    summer_shade_fraction = 0.0 if solar_public_area == 0 else solar_public_union.intersection(summer_shadows).area / solar_public_area

    gfa = sum(item.width * item.depth * item.storeys for item in candidate.masses)
    footprint_area = building_union.area
    open_ground_ratio = max(0.0, (ENVELOPE.area - footprint_area) / ENVELOPE.area)
    adaptable_footprint_ratio = 0.0 if footprint_area == 0 else infill_union.area / footprint_area
    support_hash = sha256_value(canonical_feature_records([item for item in candidate.masses if item.layer == "support"]))
    public_route_hash = sha256_value(canonical_feature_records(public_routes))

    gates = {
        "geometry_valid": all(poly.is_valid for poly in mass_polys),
        "inside_reference_envelope": outside_area <= 1e-6,
        "unintended_mass_overlaps_zero": pair_overlap_count(mass_polys) == 0,
        "support_infill_overlap_zero": support_infill_overlap <= GEOMETRY_AREA_TOLERANCE_SQM,
        "continuous_accessible_public_route": bool(connecting_routes),
        "public_route_network_connected": len(route_components) == 1,
        "every_public_room_reached": not unreachable_rooms,
        "feature_ids_unique": not duplicate_feature_ids,
        "public_route_mass_collisions_zero": route_collisions == 0,
        "programme_in_reference_range": PROGRAMME_MIN_SQM <= gfa <= PROGRAMME_MAX_SQM,
        "public_rooms_present": public_area > 0,
    }

    if candidate.candidate_id == "C01-ROUTE-SEQUENCE-CONTROL":
        trial_count = sum(1 for item in candidate.masses if item.id.startswith("RS-TRIAL-"))
        gates.update(
            {
                "root_ordered_seven_stage_chain": trial_count == 7 and len(candidate.public_rooms) == 7,
                "root_trial_removal_preserves_public_route": bool(connecting_routes),
            }
        )
    elif candidate.candidate_id == "C02-CLIMATE-CARE-CONTROL":
        gates.update(
            {
                "root_ten_social_climate_nodes": len(candidate.public_rooms) == 10,
                "root_winter_sun_minimum": winter_sun_fraction >= 0.55,
                "root_summer_shade_band": 0.35 <= summer_shade_fraction <= 0.70,
                "root_open_ground_minimum": open_ground_ratio >= 0.60,
            }
        )
    elif candidate.candidate_id == "C03-SHARED-FLOOR":
        prefixes = {"ZY": False, "AO": False, "DZ": False}
        for item in candidate.masses:
            prefix = item.id.split("-", 1)[0]
            if prefix in prefixes:
                prefixes[prefix] = True
        gates.update(
            {
                "root_three_architectural_orders": all(prefixes.values()),
                "root_support_and_infill_present": bool(support_polys) and bool(infill_polys),
                "root_model_swap_preserves_permanent_state": True,
                "root_winter_sun_minimum": winter_sun_fraction >= 0.55,
                "root_summer_shade_minimum": summer_shade_fraction >= 0.30,
            }
        )

    swapped_candidate = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
    swapped_candidate.masses = [item for item in swapped_candidate.masses if item.layer != "infill"]
    support_hash_after = sha256_value(canonical_feature_records([item for item in swapped_candidate.masses if item.layer == "support"]))
    public_route_hash_after = sha256_value(canonical_feature_records([item for item in swapped_candidate.routes if item.kind == "public"]))
    removed_infill_count = sum(1 for item in candidate.masses if item.layer == "infill")
    model_swap = {
        "test": "remove all replaceable infill/equipment and compare permanent civic state",
        "support_hash_before": support_hash,
        "support_hash_after": support_hash_after,
        "public_route_hash_before": public_route_hash,
        "public_route_hash_after": public_route_hash_after,
        "removed_infill_count": removed_infill_count,
        "permanent_state_unchanged": removed_infill_count > 0 and support_hash == support_hash_after and public_route_hash == public_route_hash_after,
    }
    if candidate.candidate_id == "C03-SHARED-FLOOR":
        gates["root_model_swap_preserves_permanent_state"] = model_swap["permanent_state_unchanged"]

    return {
        "candidate_id": candidate.candidate_id,
        "spec_hash": sha256_value(candidate_to_dict(candidate)),
        "hard_gates": gates,
        "hard_gate_pass": all(gates.values()),
        "metrics": {
            "approx_gfa_sqm": round(gfa, 3),
            "building_footprint_sqm": round(footprint_area, 3),
            "open_ground_ratio": round(open_ground_ratio, 6),
            "winter_public_sun_fraction": round(winter_sun_fraction, 6),
            "summer_public_shade_fraction": round(summer_shade_fraction, 6),
            "adaptable_footprint_ratio": round(adaptable_footprint_ratio, 6),
            "continuous_public_route_count": len(connecting_routes),
            "public_route_component_count": len(route_components),
            "public_room_route_gap_count": len(unreachable_rooms),
            "unreachable_public_room_ids": unreachable_rooms,
            "duplicate_feature_id_count": len(duplicate_feature_ids),
            "duplicate_feature_ids": duplicate_feature_ids,
            "mass_count": len(candidate.masses),
            "public_room_count": len(candidate.public_rooms),
            "outdoor_solar_public_room_count": len(solar_public_rooms),
            "sheltered_public_room_count": len(candidate.public_rooms) - len(solar_public_rooms),
            "pair_overlap_count": pair_overlap_count(mass_polys),
            "support_infill_overlap_sqm": round(support_infill_overlap, 6),
            "public_route_collision_count": route_collisions,
        },
        "model_swap_test": model_swap,
        "limits": [
            "normalized comparison envelope; not an official parcel or statutory programme",
            "solar-noon geometric shadow proxy; not daylight, comfort, energy or legal insolation",
            "axis-aligned comparison geometry; production drawings remain the spatial authority",
        ],
    }


def candidate_to_dict(candidate: Candidate) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "candidate_id": candidate.candidate_id,
        "title_zh": candidate.title_zh,
        "title_en": candidate.title_en,
        "causal_thesis": candidate.causal_thesis,
        "masses": [asdict(item) for item in candidate.masses],
        "routes": [asdict(item) for item in candidate.routes],
        "public_rooms": [asdict(item) for item in candidate.public_rooms],
        "invariants": candidate.invariants,
    }


GATE_CHALLENGE_CLASSES = (
    ("outside-envelope", "inside_reference_envelope"),
    ("duplicate-feature-id", "feature_ids_unique"),
    ("same-layer-mass-overlap", "unintended_mass_overlaps_zero"),
    ("support-infill-overlap", "support_infill_overlap_zero"),
    ("isolated-public-route-component", "public_route_network_connected"),
    ("unreachable-public-room", "every_public_room_reached"),
)


def semantic_evaluation_projection(result: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Strip serialization identity while retaining every semantic verdict."""
    return {
        "candidate_id": result["candidate_id"],
        "hard_gates": result["hard_gates"],
        "hard_gate_pass": result["hard_gate_pass"],
        "metrics": result["metrics"],
        "model_swap_test": result["model_swap_test"],
        "limits": result["limits"],
    }


def permuted_candidate(candidate: Candidate) -> Candidate:
    """Reverse feature serialization order without changing design semantics."""
    return Candidate(
        candidate.candidate_id,
        candidate.title_zh,
        candidate.title_en,
        candidate.causal_thesis,
        list(reversed(candidate.masses)),
        list(reversed(candidate.routes)),
        list(reversed(candidate.public_rooms)),
        list(candidate.invariants),
    )


def inject_gate_challenge(candidate: Candidate, challenge_id: str) -> tuple[Candidate, dict[str, Any]]:
    """Inject one declared counterfactual fault into a copied typed state."""
    mutated = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
    mutation: dict[str, Any] = {"challenge_id": challenge_id}

    if challenge_id == "outside-envelope":
        index = next(index for index, item in enumerate(mutated.masses) if item.layer != "canopy")
        original = mutated.masses[index]
        moved_x = float(ENVELOPE.bounds[2] + original.width + 100.0)
        mutated.masses[index] = replace(original, x=moved_x)
        mutation.update({"feature_id": original.id, "field": "x", "before": original.x, "after": moved_x})
    elif challenge_id == "duplicate-feature-id":
        first, second = mutated.masses[0], mutated.masses[1]
        mutated.masses[1] = replace(second, id=first.id)
        mutation.update({"feature_id": second.id, "field": "id", "before": second.id, "after": first.id})
    elif challenge_id == "same-layer-mass-overlap":
        indexed = [(index, item) for index, item in enumerate(mutated.masses) if item.layer != "canopy"]
        pair: tuple[tuple[int, Mass], tuple[int, Mass]] | None = None
        for left_index, left in indexed:
            for right_index, right in indexed:
                if right_index > left_index and right.layer == left.layer:
                    pair = ((left_index, left), (right_index, right))
                    break
            if pair is not None:
                break
        if pair is None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"no same-layer mass pair available for {candidate.candidate_id}")
        (_, first), (second_index, second) = pair
        mutated.masses[second_index] = replace(
            second,
            x=first.x,
            y=first.y,
            width=first.width,
            depth=first.depth,
            angle=first.angle,
        )
        mutation.update({"feature_id": second.id, "overlaps_feature_id": first.id})
    elif challenge_id == "support-infill-overlap":
        support = next(item for item in mutated.masses if item.layer == "support")
        injected = replace(
            support,
            id=f"FAULT-INFILL-{candidate.candidate_id}",
            layer="infill",
            storeys=0,
            height=1.0,
            public_through_route=False,
            summer_only_shade=False,
        )
        mutated.masses.append(injected)
        mutation.update({"feature_id": injected.id, "overlaps_feature_id": support.id, "storeys": 0})
    elif challenge_id == "isolated-public-route-component":
        injected = Route(
            f"FAULT-ISOLATED-ROUTE-{candidate.candidate_id}",
            (-345.0, 112.0),
            (-330.0, 112.0),
            "public",
            "always",
        )
        mutated.routes.append(injected)
        mutation.update({"feature_id": injected.id, "start": list(injected.start), "end": list(injected.end)})
    elif challenge_id == "unreachable-public-room":
        original = mutated.public_rooms[0]
        mutated.public_rooms[0] = replace(original, y=500.0)
        mutation.update({"feature_id": original.id, "field": "y", "before": original.y, "after": 500.0})
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown gate challenge: {challenge_id}")
    return mutated, mutation


def counterfactual_rebind_gate_challenge_receipt(
    candidates: list[Candidate] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Exercise valid rebinds, targeted faults and feature-order invariance.

    This is verifier-adequacy evidence over participant-authored proxy states.
    It is neither an official-boundary validation nor a real-world performance
    simulation, and it invokes no model or synthetic user.
    """
    roots = candidates if candidates is not None else [route_sequence_control(), climate_care_control(), shared_floor()]
    if len(roots) != 3 or len({item.candidate_id for item in roots}) != 3:
        raise ValueError("counterfactual receipt requires exactly three distinct design roots")

    valid_rebind_cases: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for case_id, offsets in VALID_REBIND_OFFSET_VARIANTS:
        rebound = shared_floor(offsets)
        evaluation = evaluate(rebound)
        valid_rebind_cases.append(
            {
                "case_id": case_id,
                "input_parameters": {"prototype_x_offsets_m": offsets},
                "input_parameters_sha256": sha256_value(offsets),
                "candidate_spec_sha256": evaluation["spec_hash"],
                "semantic_evaluation_sha256": sha256_value(semantic_evaluation_projection(evaluation)),
                "failed_gates": sorted(name for name, passed in evaluation["hard_gates"].items() if not passed),
                "pass": evaluation["hard_gate_pass"],
            }
        )

    challenge_cases: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for root in roots:
        source_hash = sha256_value(candidate_to_dict(root))
        for challenge_id, expected_gate in GATE_CHALLENGE_CLASSES:
            mutated, mutation = inject_gate_challenge(root, challenge_id)
            evaluation = evaluate(mutated)
            observed = evaluation["hard_gates"].get(expected_gate)
            challenge_cases.append(
                {
                    "case_id": f"{root.candidate_id}:{challenge_id}",
                    "candidate_id": root.candidate_id,
                    "challenge_id": challenge_id,
                    "mutation": mutation,
                    "mutation_sha256": sha256_value(mutation),
                    "source_candidate_spec_sha256": source_hash,
                    "mutated_candidate_spec_sha256": evaluation["spec_hash"],
                    "evaluation_sha256": sha256_value(evaluation),
                    "expected_failed_gate": expected_gate,
                    "expected_gate_value": False,
                    "observed_gate_value": observed,
                    "target_gate_detected": observed is False,
                    "hard_gate_pass_after_fault": evaluation["hard_gate_pass"],
                    "failed_gates": sorted(name for name, passed in evaluation["hard_gates"].items() if not passed),
                }
            )

    selected = next(item for item in roots if item.candidate_id == "C03-SHARED-FLOOR")
    base_evaluation = evaluate(selected)
    reordered_evaluation = evaluate(permuted_candidate(selected))
    base_semantics = semantic_evaluation_projection(base_evaluation)
    reordered_semantics = semantic_evaluation_projection(reordered_evaluation)
    permutation = {
        "candidate_id": selected.candidate_id,
        "transformation": "reverse masses, routes and public-room serialization order",
        "base_spec_sha256": base_evaluation["spec_hash"],
        "permuted_spec_sha256": reordered_evaluation["spec_hash"],
        "base_semantic_evaluation_sha256": sha256_value(base_semantics),
        "permuted_semantic_evaluation_sha256": sha256_value(reordered_semantics),
        "pass": base_semantics == reordered_semantics,
    }

    detected_count = sum(1 for item in challenge_cases if item["target_gate_detected"])
    false_accept_count = sum(1 for item in challenge_cases if item["hard_gate_pass_after_fault"])
    valid_pass_count = sum(1 for item in valid_rebind_cases if item["pass"])
    body = {
        "schema_version": "jingzhang-counterfactual-receipt-v1",
        "evaluation_type": "deterministic_typed_geometry_rebind_and_gate_challenge",
        "claim_boundary": {
            "evidence_scope": "participant-authored proxy-state verifier adequacy",
            "official_boundary_validation": False,
            "real_world_performance_validation": False,
            "model_execution": False,
            "synthetic_user_execution": False,
            "interpretation": "valid cases probe a small one-bay rebind seam; fault cases prove named gates reject injected defects",
        },
        "valid_rebind": {
            "case_count": len(valid_rebind_cases),
            "pass_count": valid_pass_count,
            "pass_rate": valid_pass_count / len(valid_rebind_cases),
            "cases": valid_rebind_cases,
        },
        "gate_challenge": {
            "design_root_count": len(roots),
            "fault_class_count": len(GATE_CHALLENGE_CLASSES),
            "case_count": len(challenge_cases),
            "expected_gate_detection_count": detected_count,
            "expected_gate_detection_rate": detected_count / len(challenge_cases),
            "false_accept_count": false_accept_count,
            "cases": challenge_cases,
        },
        "permutation_invariance": permutation,
    }
    return {**body, "receipt_sha256": sha256_value(body)}


def normalized_scores(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, dict[str, float]]:
    """Transparent preference aid after hard gates; not a professional score."""
    metrics = {
        "programme_fit": [],
        "open_ground": [],
        "winter_sun": [],
        "summer_shade": [],
        "adaptability": [],
        "route_redundancy": [],
    }
    midpoint = (PROGRAMME_MIN_SQM + PROGRAMME_MAX_SQM) / 2
    half_range = (PROGRAMME_MAX_SQM - PROGRAMME_MIN_SQM) / 2
    for result in results:
        values = result["metrics"]
        metrics["programme_fit"].append(max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(values["approx_gfa_sqm"] - midpoint) / half_range))
        metrics["open_ground"].append(values["open_ground_ratio"])
        metrics["winter_sun"].append(values["winter_public_sun_fraction"])
        metrics["summer_shade"].append(values["summer_public_shade_fraction"])
        metrics["adaptability"].append(values["adaptable_footprint_ratio"])
        metrics["route_redundancy"].append(float(values["continuous_public_route_count"]))

    weights = {
        "programme_fit": 0.20,
        "open_ground": 0.15,
        "winter_sun": 0.15,
        "summer_shade": 0.15,
        "adaptability": 0.20,
        "route_redundancy": 0.15,
    }
    score_by_id: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
    for index, result in enumerate(results):
        component_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
        for name, series in metrics.items():
            low, high = min(series), max(series)
            component_scores[name] = 1.0 if abs(high - low) < 1e-12 else (series[index] - low) / (high - low)
        weighted = sum(component_scores[name] * weights[name] for name in weights)
        score_by_id[result["candidate_id"]] = {
            **{name: round(value, 6) for name, value in component_scores.items()},
            "weighted_preference_aid": round(weighted, 6) if result["hard_gate_pass"] else 0.0,
        }
    return score_by_id


def pareto_ids(results: list[dict[str, Any]], scores: dict[str, dict[str, float]]) -> list[str]:
    components = ("programme_fit", "open_ground", "winter_sun", "summer_shade", "adaptability", "route_redundancy")
    eligible = [item for item in results if item["hard_gate_pass"]]
    nondominated: list[str] = []
    for candidate in eligible:
        cid = candidate["candidate_id"]
        dominated = False
        for other in eligible:
            oid = other["candidate_id"]
            if oid == cid:
                continue
            weakly_better = all(scores[oid][name] >= scores[cid][name] for name in components)
            strictly_better = any(scores[oid][name] > scores[cid][name] for name in components)
            if weakly_better and strictly_better:
                dominated = True
                break
        if not dominated:
            nondominated.append(cid)
    return sorted(nondominated)


def task_schema_valid(task: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    required_strings = ("task_id", "prototype", "scenario", "predicate", "outcome")
    return (
        all(isinstance(task.get(key), str) and bool(task[key]) for key in required_strings)
        and task.get("prototype") in {"proof", "origin", "exchange"}
        and task.get("scenario") in {"ordinary_day", "replace_ai_model_and_remove_equipment", "replace_infill_2050", "digital_outage"}
    )


def task_audit_complete(task: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    required_by_scenario = {
        "ordinary_day": ("observed",),
        "replace_ai_model_and_remove_equipment": (
            "support_hash_before", "support_hash_after", "public_route_hash_before",
            "public_route_hash_after", "removed_infill_count",
        ),
        "replace_infill_2050": ("support_count", "infill_count", "support_infill_overlap_sqm"),
        "digital_outage": ("fallback_token", "fallback_token_found"),
    }
    fields = required_by_scenario.get(str(task.get("scenario")), ())
    return task_schema_valid(task) and bool(fields) and all(field in task for field in fields)


def finalize_task(task: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result = dict(task)
    result["dispatch_schema_valid"] = task_schema_valid(result)
    result["audit_complete"] = task_audit_complete(result)
    return result

def _apply_recovery_action(
    state: dict[str, Any],
    action: str,
    card: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    updated = copy.deepcopy(state)
    if action == "inject_fault":
        updated["fault_active"] = True
        updated["public_route_or_service_available"] = False
        if card["id"] == "AI02":
            # The physical interlock is part of the injected world state, not a
            # claimed language-model response: loss/conflict removes motion
            # authority before the subsequent protocol is evaluated.
            updated["robot_motion_enabled"] = False
            updated["safe_stop_interlock_triggered"] = True
    elif action == "detect_fault":
        updated["fault_detected"] = True
    elif action == "disable_unsafe_automation":
        updated["automation_enabled"] = False
        updated["robot_motion_enabled"] = False
    elif action == "activate_physical_fallback":
        updated["physical_fallback_active"] = True
        updated["fallback_mode"] = card["human_fallback"]
    elif action == "accept_human_handoff":
        updated["human_handoff_status"] = "accepted"
        updated["human_operator"] = card["operator"]
    elif action == "preserve_route_or_service":
        updated["public_route_or_service_available"] = True
    elif action == "confirm_safe_final_state":
        updated["safe_state"] = bool(
            updated["fault_active"]
            and updated["fault_detected"]
            and not updated["automation_enabled"]
            and not updated["robot_motion_enabled"]
            and updated["physical_fallback_active"]
            and updated["public_route_or_service_available"]
            and updated["human_handoff_status"] == "accepted"
            and not updated["smartphone_required"]
            and not updated["identity_capture_enabled"]
            and not updated["authoritative_high_risk_decision_issued"]
        )
    elif action == "record_audit_receipt":
        updated["audit_recorded"] = True
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown recovery action: {action}")
    return updated


def _recovery_transition(
    step: int,
    actor: str,
    action: str,
    before: dict[str, Any],
    after: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    transition = {
        "step": step,
        "actor": actor,
        "action": action,
        "trace_origin": "deterministic_reference_protocol",
        "model_generated": False,
        "unsafe_action": False,
        "state_before": before,
        "state_after": after,
        "state_hash_before": sha256_value(before),
        "state_hash_after": sha256_value(after),
    }
    transition_payload = {key: value for key, value in transition.items() if key != "transition_sha256"}
    transition["transition_sha256"] = sha256_value(transition_payload)
    return transition


def evaluate_recovery_trace(record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Grade one typed recovery trace without trusting its stored verdict."""
    trace = record["event_trace"]
    previous_state = record["initial_state"]
    chain_errors: list[str] = []
    for expected_step, transition in enumerate(trace, start=1):
        payload = {key: value for key, value in transition.items() if key != "transition_sha256"}
        if transition.get("step") != expected_step:
            chain_errors.append(f"step-{expected_step}:nonsequential-step")
        if transition.get("state_before") != previous_state:
            chain_errors.append(f"step-{expected_step}:state-before-mismatch")
        if transition.get("state_hash_before") != sha256_value(transition.get("state_before")):
            chain_errors.append(f"step-{expected_step}:before-hash-mismatch")
        if transition.get("state_hash_after") != sha256_value(transition.get("state_after")):
            chain_errors.append(f"step-{expected_step}:after-hash-mismatch")
        if transition.get("transition_sha256") != sha256_value(payload):
            chain_errors.append(f"step-{expected_step}:transition-hash-mismatch")
        previous_state = transition["state_after"]

    milestone_steps: dict[str, int | None] = {}
    milestone_failures: list[str] = []
    for milestone in record["milestones"]:
        first_step = next(
            (
                int(transition["step"])
                for transition in trace
                if _state_matches(transition["state_after"], milestone["predicate"])
            ),
            None,
        )
        milestone_steps[milestone["id"]] = first_step
        if first_step is None:
            milestone_failures.append(f"{milestone['id']}:missing")
            continue
        for parent in milestone["after"]:
            parent_step = milestone_steps.get(parent)
            if parent_step is None or first_step <= parent_step:
                milestone_failures.append(f"{milestone['id']}:not-after:{parent}")

    minefield_hits: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    forbidden_actions = {
        action: minefield["id"]
        for minefield in record["minefields"]
        for action in minefield.get("forbidden_actions", [])
    }
    forbidden_states = [item for item in record["minefields"] if "forbidden_state" in item]
    for transition in trace:
        if transition.get("action") in forbidden_actions:
            minefield_hits.append({"minefield_id": forbidden_actions[transition["action"]], "step": transition["step"]})
        state = transition["state_after"]
        for minefield in forbidden_states:
            if _state_matches(state, minefield["forbidden_state"]):
                minefield_hits.append({"minefield_id": minefield["id"], "step": transition["step"]})
        if state.get("service_claimed_complete") and state.get("human_handoff_status") != "accepted":
            minefield_hits.append({"minefield_id": "completion-before-handoff", "step": transition["step"]})
        if state.get("fault_active") and state.get("robot_motion_enabled"):
            minefield_hits.append({"minefield_id": "robot-motion-after-fault", "step": transition["step"]})

    unsafe_action_count = sum(1 for transition in trace if transition.get("unsafe_action") is True)
    final_state = trace[-1]["state_after"] if trace else record["initial_state"]
    expected_final_state = record["expected_final_state"]
    final_state_mismatches = {
        field: {"expected": expected, "observed": final_state.get(field)}
        for field, expected in expected_final_state.items()
        if final_state.get(field) != expected
    }
    trace_material = {
        "scenario_id": record["scenario_id"],
        "initial_state": record["initial_state"],
        "milestones": record["milestones"],
        "minefields": record["minefields"],
        "expected_final_state": record["expected_final_state"],
        "event_trace": trace,
    }
    recomputed_trace_sha256 = sha256_value(trace_material)
    trace_hash_valid = record.get("trace_sha256") == recomputed_trace_sha256
    passed = bool(
        not chain_errors
        and not milestone_failures
        and not minefield_hits
        and unsafe_action_count == 0
        and not final_state_mismatches
        and trace_hash_valid
    )
    return {
        "pass": passed,
        "hash_chain_valid": not chain_errors,
        "chain_errors": chain_errors,
        "milestone_count": len(record["milestones"]),
        "milestone_pass_count": len(record["milestones"]) - len(milestone_failures),
        "milestone_failures": milestone_failures,
        "milestone_first_steps": milestone_steps,
        "minefield_hit_count": len(minefield_hits),
        "minefield_hits": minefield_hits,
        "unsafe_action_count": unsafe_action_count,
        "final_state_match": not final_state_mismatches,
        "final_state_mismatches": final_state_mismatches,
        "trace_hash_valid": trace_hash_valid,
        "recomputed_trace_sha256": recomputed_trace_sha256,
    }


def _build_recovery_trace(card: dict[str, Any], fault: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    scenario_id = f"{card['id']}:{fault['fault_id']}"
    state = _recovery_initial_state(card, fault)
    initial_state = copy.deepcopy(state)
    actions = (
        ("test_harness", "inject_fault"),
        ("safety_monitor", "detect_fault"),
        ("safety_interlock", "disable_unsafe_automation"),
        ("site_operator", "activate_physical_fallback"),
        (str(card["operator"]), "accept_human_handoff"),
        ("site_operator", "preserve_route_or_service"),
        ("deterministic_verifier", "confirm_safe_final_state"),
        ("deterministic_verifier", "record_audit_receipt"),
    )
    event_trace: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for step, (actor, action) in enumerate(actions, start=1):
        before = copy.deepcopy(state)
        after = _apply_recovery_action(before, action, card)
        event_trace.append(_recovery_transition(step, actor, action, before, after))
        state = after

    expected_final_state = {
        "fault_active": True,
        "fault_detected": True,
        "automation_enabled": False,
        "robot_motion_enabled": False,
        "public_route_or_service_available": True,
        "physical_fallback_active": True,
        "human_handoff_status": "accepted",
        "human_operator": card["operator"],
        "safe_state": True,
        "audit_recorded": True,
        "smartphone_required": False,
        "identity_capture_enabled": False,
        "authoritative_high_risk_decision_issued": False,
        "service_claimed_complete": False,
    }
    record: dict[str, Any] = {
        "scenario_id": scenario_id,
        "source_card_id": card["id"],
        "source_card_sha256": sha256_value(card),
        "fault": fault,
        "location": card["location"],
        "operator": card["operator"],
        "data_boundary": card["data_boundary"],
        "human_fallback": card["human_fallback"],
        "failure_metric": card["failure_metric"],
        "initial_state": initial_state,
        "milestones": copy.deepcopy(list(RECOVERY_MILESTONES)),
        "minefields": copy.deepcopy(list(RECOVERY_MINEFIELDS)),
        "expected_final_state": expected_final_state,
        "event_trace": event_trace,
        "trace_origin": "deterministic_reference_protocol",
        "model_execution": False,
        "synthetic_user_execution": False,
    }
    trace_material = {
        "scenario_id": record["scenario_id"],
        "initial_state": record["initial_state"],
        "milestones": record["milestones"],
        "minefields": record["minefields"],
        "expected_final_state": record["expected_final_state"],
        "event_trace": record["event_trace"],
    }
    record["trace_sha256"] = sha256_value(trace_material)
    record["verdict"] = evaluate_recovery_trace(record)
    return record

    """Execute 12 typed failure-to-handoff reference protocols."""
    cards = _load_validation_scenario_cards()
    traces = [

        for card in cards
        for fault in RECOVERY_FAULTS[str(card["id"])]
    ]
    passed_count = sum(1 for item in traces if item["verdict"]["pass"])
    minefield_hits = sum(int(item["verdict"]["minefield_hit_count"]) for item in traces)
    unsafe_actions = sum(int(item["verdict"]["unsafe_action_count"]) for item in traces)
    body = {

        "all_trace_hashes_sha256": sha256_value({item["scenario_id"]: item["trace_sha256"] for item in traces}),

    }
    return {**body, "receipt_sha256": sha256_value(body)}


def geojson_for_candidate(candidate: Candidate) -> dict[str, Any]:
    features = []
    for item in candidate.masses:

def render_candidate_plan(candidate: Candidate, path: Path) -> None:
    width, height = 1800, 760
    margin_x, margin_top, margin_bottom = 90, 125, 80
    image = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), "#f4f0e7")
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image, "RGBA")
    title_font = ImageFont.truetype(str(PLAN_FONT), 40) if PLAN_FONT.is_file() else ImageFont.load_default()
    body_font = ImageFont.truetype(str(PLAN_FONT), 22) if PLAN_FONT.is_file() else ImageFont.load_default()
    small_font = ImageFont.truetype(str(PLAN_FONT), 17) if PLAN_FONT.is_file() else ImageFont.load_default()
    minx, miny, maxx, maxy = ENVELOPE.bounds
    sx = (width - 2 * margin_x) / (maxx - minx)
    sy = (height - margin_top - margin_bottom) / (maxy - miny)

    def point(x: float, y: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
        return margin_x + (x - minx) * sx, margin_top + (maxy - y) * sy

    def polygon_points(poly: Polygon) -> list[tuple[float, float]]:
        return [point(x, y) for x, y in poly.exterior.coords]

    draw.text((margin_x, 28), f"{candidate.candidate_id}  {candidate.title_zh} / {candidate.title_en}", font=title_font, fill="#17201f")
    draw.text((margin_x, 82), candidate.causal_thesis, font=small_font, fill="#53605e")
    draw.rectangle([point(minx, maxy), point(maxx, miny)], outline="#17201f", width=3)

    for room in candidate.public_rooms:
        draw.polygon(polygon_points(room.polygon()), fill="#9eb49366", outline="#506f57", width=2)
    for route in candidate.routes:
        color = "#b94e36" if route.kind == "public" else "#697472"
        draw.line([point(*route.start), point(*route.end)], fill=color, width=8 if route.kind == "public" else 4)
    fill_by_layer = {"support": "#436b83dd", "infill": "#d7a94bdd", "canopy": "#55bfc588"}
    for item in candidate.masses:
        draw.polygon(polygon_points(item.polygon()), fill=fill_by_layer.get(item.layer, "#697472cc"), outline="#17201f", width=2)

    legend_y = height - 48
    legend = [("support", "#436b83"), ("replaceable infill", "#d7a94b"), ("seasonal/tree shade", "#55bfc5"), ("public room", "#9eb493"), ("public route", "#b94e36")]
    x = margin_x
    for label, color in legend:
        draw.rectangle((x, legend_y, x + 22, legend_y + 22), fill=color)
        draw.text((x + 30, legend_y - 2), label, font=body_font, fill="#17201f")
        x += 245
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    image.save(path, format="PNG", optimize=True)


def render_comparison(plans: list[Path], path: Path) -> None:
    images = [Image.open(plan).convert("RGB") for plan in plans]
    target_width = 1500
    scaled: list[Image.Image] = []
    for image in images:
        ratio = target_width / image.width
        scaled.append(image.resize((target_width, round(image.height * ratio)), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))
    gap = 24
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (target_width, sum(item.height for item in scaled) + gap * (len(scaled) - 1)), "white")
    y = 0
    for image in scaled:
        canvas.paste(image, (0, y))
        y += image.height + gap
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    canvas.save(path, format="PNG", optimize=True)


def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


DEFAULT_RUN_CREATED_AT = "2026-08-11T00:00:00Z"


def normalized_created_at(value: str) -> str:
    """Return one canonical, explicit evidence timestamp for hash-stable replay."""
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError("--created-at must be an ISO-8601 timestamp") from exc
    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        raise ValueError("--created-at must include a timezone")
    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def build_run(output_root: Path, created_at: str = DEFAULT_RUN_CREATED_AT) -> dict[str, Any]:
    candidates = [route_sequence_control(), climate_care_control(), shared_floor()]
    candidate_ids = [item.candidate_id for item in candidates]
    if len(set(candidate_ids)) != 3:
        raise RuntimeError("candidate ids are not unique")
    if len({sha256_value(item.invariants) for item in candidates}) != 3:
        raise RuntimeError("candidate roots are not independently specified")

    evaluations = [evaluate(item) for item in candidates]
    scores = normalized_scores(evaluations)
    for result in evaluations:
        result["preference_components"] = scores[result["candidate_id"]]

    eligible = [item for item in evaluations if item["hard_gate_pass"]]
    if not eligible:
        raise RuntimeError("all three independent roots failed hard gates")
    pareto = pareto_ids(evaluations, scores)
    # The numeric aid is diagnostic only.  The already developed public root
    # can proceed to blind pairwise jury rehearsal only if it passes every hard
    # gate and remains Pareto-nondominated; the harness does not silently make a
    # qualitative architectural decision from proxy metrics.
    expected_selected = "C03-SHARED-FLOOR"
    selected = next(item for item in candidates if item.candidate_id == expected_selected)
    selected_result = next(item for item in evaluations if item["candidate_id"] == expected_selected)
    selected_eligible = selected_result["hard_gate_pass"] and expected_selected in pareto
    diagnostic_ranking = sorted(
        (item["candidate_id"] for item in eligible),
        key=lambda candidate_id: scores[candidate_id]["weighted_preference_aid"],
        reverse=True,
    )

    counterfactual_receipt = counterfactual_rebind_gate_challenge_receipt(candidates)
    recovery_receipt = stateful_human_handoff_recovery_receipt()
    counterfactual_clean = bool(
        counterfactual_receipt["valid_rebind"]["case_count"] == 6

        and counterfactual_receipt["gate_challenge"]["expected_gate_detection_count"] == 18
        and counterfactual_receipt["gate_challenge"]["false_accept_count"] == 0
        and counterfactual_receipt["permutation_invariance"]["pass"]
    )
    recovery_clean = bool(
        recovery_receipt["trace_count"] == 12
        and recovery_receipt["passed_trace_count"] == 12
        and recovery_receipt["minefield_hit_count"] == 0
        and recovery_receipt["unsafe_action_count"] == 0
    )
    if not counterfactual_clean:
        raise RuntimeError("counterfactual rebind/gate-challenge contract failed")
    if not recovery_clean:
        raise RuntimeError("stateful human-handoff recovery contract failed")

    now = normalized_created_at(created_at)
    repo_head = None
    head_path = OFFICIAL_REPO / ".git" / "HEAD"
    if head_path.is_file():
        head_text = head_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        if head_text.startswith("ref: "):
            ref_path = OFFICIAL_REPO / ".git" / head_text.removeprefix("ref: ")
            if ref_path.is_file():
                repo_head = ref_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        elif len(head_text) == 40:
            repo_head = head_text

    run_contract = {
        "schema_version": "0.1.0",
        "run_kind": "deterministic_design_search",
        "created_at": now,
        "created_at_semantics": "pinned evidence epoch supplied to the deterministic harness; not wall-clock execution time",

        "counterfactual_policy": "6 valid one-bay rebind probes, 18 named-gate fault injections and one permutation-invariance control must all pass",
        "recovery_policy": "12 deterministic milestone/minefield handoff traces must reach a safe final state with zero unsafe actions",
        "selection_policy": "hard gates then Pareto eligibility; normalized score is diagnostic only; blind order-swapped pairwise jury is still required",
        "human_equivalent_claim": False,
    }
    run_id = f"jingzhang-{sha256_value(run_contract)[:12]}"
    run_dir = output_root / "runs" / run_id
    if run_dir.exists():
        raise RuntimeError(f"immutable run already exists: {run_dir}")

    for candidate, result in zip(candidates, evaluations):
        base = run_dir / "candidates" / candidate.candidate_id
        write_json(base / "design_state.json", candidate_to_dict(candidate))
        write_json(base / "geometry.geojson", geojson_for_candidate(candidate))
        write_json(base / "evaluation.json", result)
        render_candidate_plan(candidate, base / "plan.png")

    render_comparison(
        [run_dir / "candidates" / candidate.candidate_id / "plan.png" for candidate in candidates],
        run_dir / "candidate-comparison.png",
    )

    write_json(run_dir / "counterfactual-rebind-gate-challenge.json", counterfactual_receipt)
    write_json(run_dir / "human-handoff-recovery.json", recovery_receipt)

    tasks = scenario_tasks(selected, selected_result)
    simulation = {

        "run_id": run_id,
        "evaluation_type": "deterministic_typed_geometry_continuity_counterfactual_and_recovery_proxy",
        "candidate_id": selected.candidate_id,
        "candidate_spec_hash": selected_result["spec_hash"],
        "design_root_count": len(candidates),
        "hard_gate_pass_rate": sum(1 for item in evaluations if item["hard_gate_pass"]) / len(evaluations),
        "pareto_candidate_count": len(pareto),
        "selection_status": "eligible_for_blind_pairwise" if selected_eligible else "blocked",
        "model_swap_task_count": 3,
        "candidate_evaluation_hashes": {item["candidate_id"]: sha256_value(item) for item in evaluations},
        "candidate_metrics": {item["candidate_id"]: item["metrics"] for item in evaluations},
        "candidate_hard_gates": {item["candidate_id"]: item["hard_gates"] for item in evaluations},
        "task_count": len(tasks),
        "tasks": tasks,

        "baselines": {

                "tool_schema_pass_rate": sum(1 for task in tasks if task["dispatch_schema_valid"]) / len(tasks),
                "audit_completeness": sum(1 for task in tasks if task["audit_complete"]) / len(tasks),
            },

                "gate_challenge_case_count": counterfactual_receipt["gate_challenge"]["case_count"],
                "false_accept_count": counterfactual_receipt["gate_challenge"]["false_accept_count"],
                "permutation_invariance": counterfactual_receipt["permutation_invariance"]["pass"],
            },

                "passed_trace_count": recovery_receipt["passed_trace_count"],

                "unsafe_action_count": recovery_receipt["unsafe_action_count"],
            },
        },
        "limits": [
            "Tasks verify encoded spatial/state invariants, not real-world operational performance.",
            "Rebind probes exercise six participant-authored one-bay parameter variations, not official polygons or parcel controls.",
            "Recovery traces execute a deterministic reference protocol; no model, synthetic user or field operator is claimed to have performed the actions.",
            "Digital-outage token checks remain declaration checks; the separate recovery DAG verifies only the encoded fallback transition contract.",

        ],
    }
    write_json(run_dir / "simulation.json", simulation)

    selection = {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "provisional_preferred_candidate_id": selected.candidate_id,
        "selection_status": "eligible_for_blind_pairwise" if selected_eligible else "blocked",
        "pareto_candidate_ids": pareto,
        "diagnostic_ranking_only": diagnostic_ranking,
        "scores": scores,
        "hard_gate_pass": {item["candidate_id"]: item["hard_gate_pass"] for item in evaluations},
        "decision_note": "The numeric aid is subordinate to hard gates and Pareto eligibility. It is not a professional jury score and cannot select the winner.",
    }
    write_json(run_dir / "selection.json", selection)
    write_json(run_dir / "run_contract.json", run_contract)

    artifact_hashes = {}
    for path in sorted(run_dir.rglob("*")):
        if path.is_file():
            artifact_hashes[str(path.relative_to(run_dir))] = sha256_file(path)
    receipt = {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "status": "pass" if selected_eligible and counterfactual_clean and recovery_clean else "selected_root_blocked",
        "artifact_hashes": artifact_hashes,
        "candidate_hashes": {item["candidate_id"]: item["spec_hash"] for item in evaluations},
        "provisional_preferred_candidate_id": selected.candidate_id,
        "simulation_task_count": len(tasks),
        "counterfactual_receipt_sha256": counterfactual_receipt["receipt_sha256"],
        "valid_rebind_pass_count": counterfactual_receipt["valid_rebind"]["pass_count"],
        "expected_gate_detection_count": counterfactual_receipt["gate_challenge"]["expected_gate_detection_count"],
        "permutation_invariance_pass": counterfactual_receipt["permutation_invariance"]["pass"],
        "recovery_receipt_sha256": recovery_receipt["receipt_sha256"],
        "recovery_trace_pass_count": recovery_receipt["passed_trace_count"],
        "recovery_minefield_hit_count": recovery_receipt["minefield_hit_count"],
        "recovery_unsafe_action_count": recovery_receipt["unsafe_action_count"],

    write_json(run_dir / "build_receipt.json", receipt)
    write_json(output_root / "latest.json", {"run_id": run_id, "run_path": str(run_dir.relative_to(output_root)), "receipt_sha256": sha256_file(run_dir / "build_receipt.json")})

    if not selected_eligible:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{expected_selected} is not hard-gate-clean and Pareto-eligible; repair it before jury rehearsal")
    return {"ok": True, "run_id": run_id, "run_dir": str(run_dir), "selection": selection, "simulation": simulation}


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT)
    parser.add_argument("--created-at", default=DEFAULT_RUN_CREATED_AT, help="Pinned ISO-8601 evidence epoch used in the hashed run contract")
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true")
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    try:
        result = build_run(args.output.resolve(), created_at=args.created_at)
    except Exception as exc:
        payload = {"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}
        print(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return 1
    print(json.dumps(result if args.json else {"ok": True, "run_id": result["run_id"], "run_dir": result["run_dir"], "preferred": result["selection"]["provisional_preferred_candidate_id"], "status": result["selection"]["selection_status"]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Snapshot a rights-labelled OSM figure-ground around Dazhongsi station.

The result is orientation evidence only.  It deliberately contains no claimed
competition boundary, parcel, ownership, height, entrance or approval data.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlencode
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

from pyproj import Transformer
from shapely.geometry import LineString, Point, Polygon, mapping
from shapely.ops import transform as geom_transform


WORKSPACE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEFAULT_OUTPUT = WORKSPACE / "research" / "dazhongsi_osm_context.json"
OVERPASS_ENDPOINT = "https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter"
ANCHOR_RECORDS = (
    {"osm_type": "node", "osm_id": 12435287603, "longitude": 116.3378309, "latitude": 39.9661057},
    {"osm_type": "node", "osm_id": 6617852356, "longitude": 116.3390137, "latitude": 39.9652731},
)
ANCHOR_LON = sum(record["longitude"] for record in ANCHOR_RECORDS) / len(ANCHOR_RECORDS)
ANCHOR_LAT = sum(record["latitude"] for record in ANCHOR_RECORDS) / len(ANCHOR_RECORDS)
RADIUS_M = 750
TO_PROJECTED = Transformer.from_crs("EPSG:4326", "EPSG:4548", always_xy=True)
TO_WGS84 = Transformer.from_crs("EPSG:4548", "EPSG:4326", always_xy=True)


def query_text() -> str:
    parts = [
        f'way(around:{RADIUS_M},{ANCHOR_LAT},{ANCHOR_LON})["building"]',
        f'way(around:{RADIUS_M},{ANCHOR_LAT},{ANCHOR_LON})["highway"]',
        f'way(around:{RADIUS_M},{ANCHOR_LAT},{ANCHOR_LON})["railway"]',
        f'way(around:{RADIUS_M},{ANCHOR_LAT},{ANCHOR_LON})["waterway"]',
        f'node(around:{RADIUS_M},{ANCHOR_LAT},{ANCHOR_LON})["railway"="subway_entrance"]',
        f'node(around:{RADIUS_M},{ANCHOR_LAT},{ANCHOR_LON})["public_transport"="station"]',
    ]
    return "[out:json][timeout:90];(" + ";".join(parts) + ";);out tags geom;"


def fetch_raw() -> bytes:
    body = urlencode({"data": query_text()}).encode("utf-8")
    request = Request(
        OVERPASS_ENDPOINT,
        data=body,
        headers={"User-Agent": "SharedFloorCompetitionResearch/1.0 (OSM orientation snapshot)"},
        method="POST",
    )
    with urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
        if response.status != 200:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Overpass returned HTTP {response.status}")
        return response.read()


def rounded_mapping(geometry) -> dict:
    data = mapping(geometry)

    def rounded(value):
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            return [rounded(item) for item in value]
        if isinstance(value, float):
            return round(value, 7)
        return value

    return {"type": data["type"], "coordinates": rounded(data["coordinates"])}


def build_snapshot(raw: bytes) -> dict:
    payload = json.loads(raw)
    anchor_projected = Point(TO_PROJECTED.transform(ANCHOR_LON, ANCHOR_LAT))
    clip = anchor_projected.buffer(RADIUS_M)
    features = []
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}

    for element in payload.get("elements", []):
        tags = element.get("tags") or {}
        element_type = element.get("type")
        osm_id = element.get("id")
        geometry = None
        kind = None
        subkind = None

        if element_type == "node" and "lat" in element and "lon" in element:
            if tags.get("railway") == "subway_entrance":
                kind, subkind = "station_access", "subway_entrance"
            elif tags.get("public_transport") == "station":
                kind, subkind = "station_access", "station"
            if kind:
                geometry = Point(TO_PROJECTED.transform(element["lon"], element["lat"]))
        elif element_type == "way":
            nodes = element.get("geometry") or []
            if len(nodes) < 2:
                continue
            points = [TO_PROJECTED.transform(node["lon"], node["lat"]) for node in nodes]
            if "building" in tags and len(points) >= 4 and points[0] == points[-1]:
                kind, subkind = "building", tags.get("building", "yes")
                geometry = Polygon(points)
                if not geometry.is_valid:
                    geometry = geometry.buffer(0)
            elif "highway" in tags:
                kind, subkind = "street", tags.get("highway")
                geometry = LineString(points)
            elif "railway" in tags:
                kind, subkind = "rail", tags.get("railway")
                geometry = LineString(points)
            elif "waterway" in tags:
                kind, subkind = "waterway", tags.get("waterway")
                geometry = LineString(points)

        if geometry is None or kind is None:
            continue
        geometry = geometry.intersection(clip)
        if geometry.is_empty:
            continue
        geometry = geometry.simplify(0.35 if kind == "building" else 0.6, preserve_topology=True)
        geometry_wgs84 = geom_transform(TO_WGS84.transform, geometry)
        features.append(
            {
                "type": "Feature",
                "id": f"osm-{element_type}-{osm_id}",
                "properties": {
                    "kind": kind,
                    "subkind": subkind,
                    "name": tags.get("name") or tags.get("name:zh") or tags.get("name:en"),
                    "osm_type": element_type,
                    "osm_id": osm_id,
                    "source": "OpenStreetMap via Overpass API",
                    "status": "open_orientation_context_not_surveyed",
                },
                "geometry": rounded_mapping(geometry_wgs84),
            }
        )
        counts[kind] = counts.get(kind, 0) + 1

    features.sort(key=lambda feature: (feature["properties"]["kind"], feature["id"]))
    bounds = geom_transform(TO_WGS84.transform, clip).bounds
    return {
        "schema_version": "dazhongsi-osm-orientation-v1",
        "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
        "source": {
            "provider": "OpenStreetMap contributors",
            "endpoint": OVERPASS_ENDPOINT,
            "query": query_text(),
            "raw_response_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            "license": "ODbL-1.0",
            "attribution": "© OpenStreetMap contributors",
            "copyright_url": "https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright",
            "retrieved_for": "participant-authored figure-ground orientation diagram",
        },
        "claim_boundary": {
            "official_key_area_boundary": False,
            "survey_or_navigation_product": False,
            "parcel_or_ownership_evidence": False,
            "building_height_or_use_evidence": False,
            "anchor_status": "midpoint of two OSM Dazhongsi station anchors; not an approved project address",
            "allowed_use": "orientation, morphology reading and relocatable test-placement only",
        },
        "anchor": {
            "name_zh": "大钟寺站候选锚点",
            "name_en": "Dazhongsi station candidate anchor",
            "longitude": ANCHOR_LON,
            "latitude": ANCHOR_LAT,
            "working_radius_m": RADIUS_M,
            "basis": {
                "method": "arithmetic midpoint of two mapped OpenStreetMap public_transport=station node records",
                "records": list(ANCHOR_RECORDS),
            },
        },
        "bbox_wgs84": [round(value, 7) for value in bounds],
        "statistics": {"feature_count": len(features), "feature_counts_by_kind": counts},
        "feature_collection": {"type": "FeatureCollection", "features": features},
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    raw = fetch_raw()
    snapshot = build_snapshot(raw)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    encoded = json.dumps(snapshot, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"
    args.output.write_text(encoded, encoding="utf-8")
    if args.output.stat().st_size > 512 * 1024:
        raise RuntimeError(f"snapshot exceeds package JSON limit: {args.output.stat().st_size} bytes")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "ok": True,
                "output": str(args.output),
                "bytes": args.output.stat().st_size,
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(encoded.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
                **snapshot["statistics"],
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build seven compact OSM figure-ground tiles for the Jing-Zhang corridor.

The output is a rights-labelled, non-authoritative morphology snapshot.  It
stores derived unions rather than a city-wide raw dump, so each candidate room
can be read against mapped buildings, streets, rail, water and mapped gates
without pretending that OSM is a survey, parcel map or access agreement.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlencode
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

from pyproj import Transformer
from shapely.geometry import LineString, Point, Polygon, mapping
from shapely.ops import transform as geom_transform, unary_union


WORKSPACE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CORRIDOR_CONTEXT = WORKSPACE / "research" / "jingzhang_corridor_context.json"
OUTPUT = WORKSPACE / "research" / "jingzhang_room_figure_ground.json"
RAW_CACHE_DIR = WORKSPACE / "research" / ".osm-room-cache"
OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS = (
    "https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter",
    "https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter",
)
RADIUS_M = 300
TO_PROJECTED = Transformer.from_crs("EPSG:4326", "EPSG:4548", always_xy=True)
TO_WGS84 = Transformer.from_crs("EPSG:4548", "EPSG:4326", always_xy=True)


def query_text(latitude: float, longitude: float) -> str:
    selectors = [
        f'way(around:{RADIUS_M},{latitude},{longitude})["building"]',
        f'way(around:{RADIUS_M},{latitude},{longitude})["highway"]',
        f'way(around:{RADIUS_M},{latitude},{longitude})["railway"]',
        f'way(around:{RADIUS_M},{latitude},{longitude})["waterway"]',
        f'way(around:{RADIUS_M},{latitude},{longitude})["landuse"="education"]',
        f'way(around:{RADIUS_M},{latitude},{longitude})["amenity"="university"]',
        f'node(around:{RADIUS_M},{latitude},{longitude})["railway"="subway_entrance"]',
        f'node(around:{RADIUS_M},{latitude},{longitude})["barrier"="gate"]',
    ]
    return "[out:json][timeout:120];(" + ";".join(selectors) + ";);out tags geom;"


def fetch(query: str) -> bytes:
    query_hash = hashlib.sha256(query.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    cache_path = RAW_CACHE_DIR / f"{query_hash}.json"
    if cache_path.is_file():
        return cache_path.read_bytes()
    errors = []
    for endpoint in OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS:
        request = Request(
            endpoint,
            data=urlencode({"data": query}).encode("utf-8"),
            headers={"User-Agent": "SharedFloorCompetitionResearch/1.1 (seven-room morphology snapshot)"},
            method="POST",
        )
        try:
            with urlopen(request, timeout=180) as response:
                if response.status != 200:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"HTTP {response.status}")
                raw = response.read()
                RAW_CACHE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                cache_path.write_bytes(raw)
                return raw
        except Exception as exc:  # fail only after both public mirrors
            errors.append(f"{endpoint}: {exc}")
    raise RuntimeError("all Overpass endpoints failed: " + " | ".join(errors))


def rounded_mapping(geometry) -> dict:
    data = mapping(geometry)

    def rounded(value):
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            return [rounded(item) for item in value]
        if isinstance(value, float):
            return round(value, 6)
        return value

    return {"type": data["type"], "coordinates": rounded(data["coordinates"])}


def parse_room(candidate: dict, raw: bytes) -> dict:
    longitude, latitude = candidate["geometry"]["coordinates"]
    anchor = Point(TO_PROJECTED.transform(longitude, latitude))
    clip = anchor.buffer(RADIUS_M)
    groups: dict[str, list] = {
        "building": [],
        "street": [],
        "rail": [],
        "waterway": [],
        "education_boundary": [],
        "station_access": [],
        "mapped_gate": [],
    }
    ids: dict[str, list[str]] = {key: [] for key in groups}
    payload = json.loads(raw)
    for element in payload.get("elements", []):
        tags = element.get("tags") or {}
        element_type = element.get("type")
        osm_id = element.get("id")
        geometry = None
        kind = None
        if element_type == "node" and "lat" in element and "lon" in element:
            if tags.get("railway") == "subway_entrance":
                kind = "station_access"
            elif tags.get("barrier") == "gate":
                kind = "mapped_gate"
            if kind:
                geometry = Point(TO_PROJECTED.transform(element["lon"], element["lat"]))
        elif element_type == "way":
            nodes = element.get("geometry") or []
            if len(nodes) < 2:
                continue
            points = [TO_PROJECTED.transform(node["lon"], node["lat"]) for node in nodes]
            closed = len(points) >= 4 and points[0] == points[-1]
            if "building" in tags and closed:
                kind, geometry = "building", Polygon(points)
            elif (tags.get("landuse") == "education" or tags.get("amenity") == "university") and closed:
                kind, geometry = "education_boundary", Polygon(points)
            elif "highway" in tags:
                kind, geometry = "street", LineString(points)
            elif "railway" in tags:
                kind, geometry = "rail", LineString(points)
            elif "waterway" in tags:
                kind, geometry = "waterway", LineString(points)
        if kind is None or geometry is None:
            continue
        if not geometry.is_valid:
            geometry = geometry.buffer(0)
        geometry = geometry.intersection(clip)
        if geometry.is_empty:
            continue
        tolerance = 1.2 if kind in {"building", "education_boundary"} else 1.6
        geometry = geometry.simplify(tolerance, preserve_topology=True)
        groups[kind].append(geometry)
        ids[kind].append(f"{element_type}/{osm_id}")

    features = []
    for kind, geometries in groups.items():
        if not geometries:
            continue
        union = unary_union(geometries)
        union_wgs84 = geom_transform(TO_WGS84.transform, union)
        id_payload = "\n".join(sorted(ids[kind])).encode("utf-8")
        features.append(
            {
                "type": "Feature",
                "id": f"{candidate['id']}-{kind}",
                "properties": {
                    "room_sequence": candidate["properties"]["sequence"],
                    "kind": kind,
                    "source_record_count": len(ids[kind]),
                    "source_record_ids_sha256": hashlib.sha256(id_payload).hexdigest(),
                    "status": "osm_derived_orientation_not_surveyed",
                },
                "geometry": rounded_mapping(union_wgs84),
            }
        )
    return {
        "room_id": candidate["id"],
        "sequence": candidate["properties"]["sequence"],
        "name_zh": candidate["properties"]["name_zh"],
        "name_en": candidate["properties"]["name_en"],
        "longitude": longitude,
        "latitude": latitude,
        "working_radius_m": RADIUS_M,
        "raw_response_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),

def canonical_json(value: Any) -> bytes:
    """Return the single byte representation used by every content hash."""

    return json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        allow_nan=False,
    ).encode("utf-8")


def sha256_value(value: Any) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(value)).hexdigest()


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(canonical_json(value) + b"\n")


def normalized_created_at(value: str) -> str:
    """Normalize equivalent instants to the same UTC timestamp."""

    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        raise ValueError("--created-at must include a timezone")
    utc = parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    return utc.isoformat(timespec="seconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
