        for topology in TOPOLOGY_SPECS
    }
    coverage = {
        "contracts_with_all_three_fixture_kinds": sum(
            {fixture["kind"] for fixture in contract["fixtures"]}
            == set(FIXTURE_KINDS)
            for contract in contracts
        ),
        "contracts_with_permanent_H_path": sum(
            bool(contract["permanent_h_path"]["available"])
            and bool(contract["permanent_h_path"]["cannot_be_removed_by_model_swap"])
            for contract in contracts
        ),
        "contracts_with_two_key_policy": sum(
            tuple(contract["promotion_policy"]["required_independent_keys"])
            == PROMOTION_KEYS
            and contract["promotion_policy"]["minimum_key_count"] == 2
            for contract in contracts
        ),
        "contracts_with_deny_by_default_rollback": sum(
            contract["rollback_policy"]["default_allow"] is False
            for contract in contracts
        ),
        "contracts_per_site_topology": topology_counts,
    }
    status = (
        "pass"
        if len(contracts) == 12
        and len(receipts) == 36
        and eligible_count == 8
        and held_count == 4
        and unsafe_promotion_count == 0
        and all(value == 12 for key, value in coverage.items() if key != "contracts_per_site_topology")
        and set(topology_counts.values()) == {4}
        else "fail"
    )
    return {
        "schema": "shared-floor-changeover-verification/v1",
        "method_version": METHOD_VERSION,
        "status": status,
        "claim_boundary": CLAIM_BOUNDARY,
        "summary": {
            "topology_count": len(TOPOLOGY_SPECS),
            "witness_landmark_count": len({item["landmark_id"] for item in TOPOLOGY_SPECS}),
            "interface_component_count": len(INTERFACE_KIT),
            "honor_display_count": sum(1 for item in TOPOLOGY_SPECS if item.get("honor_display")),
            "contract_count": len(contracts),
            "fixture_count": len(receipts),
            "delta_receipt_count": len(receipts),
            "safe_candidate_count": sum(item["safe_candidate"] for item in results),
            "unsafe_candidate_count": sum(
                item["injected_contract_regression"] for item in results
            ),
            "eligible_for_live_shadow_count": eligible_count,
            "held_contract_regression_count": held_count,
            "unsafe_eligible_count": sum(
                item["injected_contract_regression"]
                and item["candidate_state"] == "eligible_for_live_shadow"
                for item in results
            ),
            "unsafe_promotion_count": unsafe_promotion_count,
            "promotion_executed_count": sum(item["promotion_executed"] for item in results),
        },
        "coverage": coverage,
        "contract_results": results,
        "delta_receipts": receipts,
    }


def build_run(output_root: Path, created_at: str = DEFAULT_RUN_CREATED_AT) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Materialize one immutable, reproducible verifier run."""

    normalized_time = normalized_created_at(created_at)
    contracts = build_contracts()
    verification = build_verification(contracts)
    topologies = {
        "schema": "shared-floor-changeover-topologies/v1",
        "topologies": list(TOPOLOGY_SPECS),
        "interface_kit": list(INTERFACE_KIT),
    }
    contract_set = {
        "schema": "shared-floor-changeover-contracts/v1",
        "contracts": contracts,
    }
    run_contract = {
        "schema": "shared-floor-changeover-run/v1",
        "method_version": METHOD_VERSION,
        "created_at": normalized_time,
        "runner_sha256": sha256_file(RUNNER_PATH),
        "topology_spec_sha256": sha256_value(topologies),
        "contract_set_sha256": sha256_value(contract_set),
        "fixture_kinds": list(FIXTURE_KINDS),
        "promotion_keys": list(PROMOTION_KEYS),
        "claim_boundary": CLAIM_BOUNDARY,
    }
    run_id = f"shared-floor-changeover-{sha256_value(run_contract)[:16]}"
    run_dir = output_root / "runs" / run_id
    if run_dir.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"immutable run already exists: {run_dir}")

    write_json(run_dir / "run_contract.json", run_contract)
    write_json(run_dir / "topologies.json", topologies)
    write_json(run_dir / "contracts.json", contract_set)
    write_json(run_dir / "verification.json", verification)
    for receipt in verification["delta_receipts"]:
        write_json(
            run_dir / "delta_receipts" / f"{receipt['receipt_sha256']}.json",
            receipt,
        )

    artifact_hashes = {
        path.relative_to(run_dir).as_posix(): sha256_file(path)
        for path in sorted(run_dir.rglob("*.json"))
    }
    build_receipt = {
        "schema": "shared-floor-changeover-build-receipt/v1",
        "method_version": METHOD_VERSION,
        "run_id": run_id,
        "created_at": normalized_time,
        "status": verification["status"],
        "summary": verification["summary"],
        "coverage": verification["coverage"],
        "claim_boundary": CLAIM_BOUNDARY,
        "artifact_sha256": artifact_hashes,
    }
    build_receipt_path = run_dir / "build_receipt.json"
    write_json(build_receipt_path, build_receipt)
    build_receipt_sha256 = sha256_file(build_receipt_path)
    latest = {
        "schema": "shared-floor-changeover-latest/v1",
        "run_id": run_id,
        "run_path": f"runs/{run_id}",
        "build_receipt_sha256": build_receipt_sha256,
    }
    write_json(output_root / "latest.json", latest)
    return {
        "ok": verification["status"] == "pass",
        "run_id": run_id,
        "run_dir": str(run_dir),
        "build_receipt_sha256": build_receipt_sha256,
        "summary": verification["summary"],
        "claim_boundary": CLAIM_BOUNDARY,
    }


def parse_args(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Run the deterministic Shared Floor A/B/H changeover verifier."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output",
        type=Path,
        default=Path("artifacts/shared-floor-changeover"),
        help="Output root containing immutable runs/ and latest.json.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--created-at",
        default=DEFAULT_RUN_CREATED_AT,
        help="Timezone-aware ISO-8601 run epoch; equivalent instants share a run id.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Print the result as canonical JSON.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    try:
        result = build_run(args.output, args.created_at)
    except Exception as exc:  # CLI boundary: return a machine-readable failure.
        error = {"ok": False, "error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}
        if args.json:
            print(canonical_json(error).decode("utf-8"))
        else:
            print(f"ERROR {error['error']}: {error['message']}")
        return 1

    if args.json:
        print(canonical_json(result).decode("utf-8"))
    else:
        summary = result["summary"]
        print(f"PASS {result['run_id']}")
        print(
            "12 contracts / 36 fixtures / "
            f"{summary['eligible_for_live_shadow_count']} eligible / "
            f"{summary['held_contract_regression_count']} held"
        )
        print(CLAIM_BOUNDARY["claim"])
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def canonical_json(value: Any) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")


def sha256_value(value: Any) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(value)).hexdigest()


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(canonical_json(value) + b"\n")


def read_json_object(path: Path, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not path.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError(f"changeover {label} is missing: {path}")
    try:
        value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot read changeover {label}: {exc}") from exc
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise RuntimeError(f"changeover {label} must be a JSON object")
    return value


def _is_sha256(value: Any) -> bool:
    return (
        isinstance(value, str)
        and len(value) == 64
        and all(character in "0123456789abcdef" for character in value)
    )


def load_verified_changeover_evidence(latest_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Verify the immutable changeover authority used by delivery records."""

    latest_path = latest_path.expanduser().resolve()
    latest = read_json_object(latest_path, "latest pointer")
    if latest.get("schema") != "shared-floor-changeover-latest/v1":
        raise RuntimeError("changeover latest pointer schema mismatch")
    run_id = latest.get("run_id")
    run_path = latest.get("run_path")
    if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id:
        raise RuntimeError("changeover latest pointer lacks run_id")
    if run_path != f"runs/{run_id}":
        raise RuntimeError("changeover latest pointer run identity mismatch")

    changeover_root = latest_path.parent
    runs_root = (changeover_root / "runs").resolve()
    run_dir = (changeover_root / run_path).resolve()
    if runs_root not in run_dir.parents:
        raise RuntimeError("changeover latest pointer escapes immutable runs")

    build_receipt_path = run_dir / "build_receipt.json"
    build_receipt = read_json_object(build_receipt_path, "build receipt")
    expected_build_receipt_sha256 = latest.get("build_receipt_sha256")
    if not _is_sha256(expected_build_receipt_sha256):
        raise RuntimeError("changeover latest pointer has invalid build receipt hash")
    if sha256_file(build_receipt_path) != expected_build_receipt_sha256:
        raise RuntimeError("changeover build receipt hash mismatch")
    if (
        build_receipt.get("schema")
        != "shared-floor-changeover-build-receipt/v1"
        or build_receipt.get("run_id") != run_id
        or build_receipt.get("status") != "pass"
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("changeover build receipt identity or status mismatch")

    artifact_hashes = build_receipt.get("artifact_sha256")
    if not isinstance(artifact_hashes, dict):
        raise RuntimeError("changeover build receipt lacks artifact hashes")

    if not CHANGEOVER_RUNNER_PATH.is_file():

    for key in (

def normalized_created_at(value: str) -> str:
    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        raise ValueError("--created-at must include a timezone")
    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _package_reference_record(package_root: Path, reference: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    relative_path, separator, fragment = reference.partition("#")
    if not relative_path or Path(relative_path).is_absolute():
        raise ValueError(f"package reference must be relative: {reference}")
    root = package_root.resolve()
    path = (root / relative_path).resolve()
    try:
        path.relative_to(root)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"package reference escapes package root: {reference}") from exc
    if not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"package reference is missing: {reference}")

    record: dict[str, Any] = {
        "reference": reference,
        "path": relative_path,
        "sha256": sha256_file(path),
        "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
    }
    if separator:
        if path.suffix.lower() not in {".json", ".geojson"}:
            raise ValueError(f"fragment requires JSON/GeoJSON: {reference}")
        payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        features = payload.get("features") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(features, list):
            raise ValueError(f"fragment requires a GeoJSON feature collection: {reference}")
        matched = [
            feature
            for feature in features
            if isinstance(feature, dict)
            and (
                feature.get("id") == fragment
                or (isinstance(feature.get("properties"), dict) and feature["properties"].get("id") == fragment)
            )
        ]
        if len(matched) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                f"package reference fragment must match one feature ({len(matched)}): {reference}"
            )
        record["fragment"] = fragment
        record["matched_feature_count"] = 1
    return record


def build_package_input_snapshot(package_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    references = sorted(
        {
            reference
            for project in PROJECT_SPECS
            for reference in project["geometry_refs"]
        }
    )
    inputs = [
        _package_reference_record(package_root, reference)
        for reference in references
    ]
    body = {
        "schema": "shared-floor-delivery-package-inputs/v1",
        "package_root_policy": "submission/shared-floor-jingzhang; absolute path omitted",
        "inputs": inputs,
    }
    body["input_set_sha256"] = sha256_value(body)
    return body

def _programme_is_acyclic(activities: Sequence[dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
    task_ids = [activity.get("task_id") for activity in activities]
    if any(not isinstance(task_id, str) for task_id in task_ids):
        return False
    if len(task_ids) != len(set(task_ids)):
        return False
    known_ids = set(task_ids)
    predecessors = {
        activity["task_id"]: set(activity.get("predecessor_task_ids", []))
        for activity in activities
    }
    if any(task_id in dependencies or not dependencies <= known_ids for task_id, dependencies in predecessors.items()):
        return False
    completed: set[str] = set()
    while len(completed) < len(known_ids):
        ready = {
            task_id
            for task_id, dependencies in predecessors.items()
            if task_id not in completed and dependencies <= completed
        }
        if not ready:
            return False
        completed.update(ready)
    return True

def build_run(
    output_root: Path,
    created_at: str = DEFAULT_RUN_CREATED_AT,
    package_root: Path = DEFAULT_PACKAGE_ROOT,
    changeover_latest: Path = DEFAULT_CHANGEOVER_LATEST,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    normalized_time = normalized_created_at(created_at)
    dossier = build_dossier(package_root, changeover_latest)
    package_inputs = dossier["package_input_snapshot"]
    changeover_binding = dossier["changeover_binding"]
    run_contract = {
        "schema": "shared-floor-delivery-run/v3",
        "method_version": METHOD_VERSION,
        "created_at": normalized_time,
        "runner_sha256": sha256_file(RUNNER_PATH),
        "beijing_guide": BEIJING_GUIDE,
        "package_input_set_sha256": package_inputs["input_set_sha256"],
        "package_input_count": len(package_inputs["inputs"]),
        "changeover_binding": {
            "artifact": "changeover_binding.json",
            "schema": changeover_binding["schema"],
            "sha256": sha256_value(changeover_binding),
            "run_id": changeover_binding["run_id"],
            "build_receipt_sha256": changeover_binding[
                "build_receipt_sha256"
            ],
        },
        "claim_boundary": CLAIM_BOUNDARY,
    }
    run_id = f"shared-floor-delivery-{sha256_value(run_contract)[:16]}"
    output_root = output_root.resolve()
    runs_root = output_root / "runs"
    run_dir = runs_root / run_id
    if run_dir.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"immutable run already exists: {run_dir}")
    verification = dossier["verification"]
    runs_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stage_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".delivery-", dir=runs_root))
    try:
        write_json(stage_dir / "run_contract.json", run_contract)
        for key, value in dossier.items():
            write_json(stage_dir / f"{key}.json", value)
        artifact_hashes = {
            path.relative_to(stage_dir).as_posix(): sha256_file(path)
            for path in sorted(stage_dir.glob("*.json"))
        }
        build_receipt = {
            "schema": "shared-floor-delivery-build-receipt/v2",
            "method_version": METHOD_VERSION,
            "run_id": run_id,
            "created_at": normalized_time,
            "status": verification["status"],
            "summary": verification["summary"],
            "claim_boundary": CLAIM_BOUNDARY,
            "artifact_sha256": artifact_hashes,
        }
        build_receipt_path = stage_dir / "build_receipt.json"
        write_json(build_receipt_path, build_receipt)
        build_receipt_sha256 = sha256_file(build_receipt_path)
        stage_dir.rename(run_dir)
    except Exception:
        if stage_dir.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(stage_dir)
        raise

    latest = {
        "schema": "shared-floor-delivery-latest/v1",
        "run_id": run_id,
        "run_path": f"runs/{run_id}",
        "build_receipt_sha256": build_receipt_sha256,
    }
    latest_tmp = output_root / ".latest.json.tmp"
    write_json(latest_tmp, latest)
    os.replace(latest_tmp, output_root / "latest.json")
    return {
        "ok": verification["status"] == "pass",
        "run_id": run_id,
        "run_dir": str(run_dir),
        "build_receipt_sha256": build_receipt_sha256,
        "summary": verification["summary"],
        "claim_boundary": CLAIM_BOUNDARY,
    }


def parse_args(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build the Shared Floor fail-closed delivery dossier.")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=Path("artifacts/shared-floor-delivery"))
    parser.add_argument("--created-at", default=DEFAULT_RUN_CREATED_AT)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--package-root",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_PACKAGE_ROOT,
        help="Shared Floor package root whose source inputs are hash-bound.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--changeover-latest",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_CHANGEOVER_LATEST,
        help=(
            "Immutable changeover-v1 latest.json used as the direct topology "
            "and contract authority."
        ),
    )
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true")
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    try:
        result = build_run(
            args.output,
            created_at=args.created_at,
            package_root=args.package_root,
            changeover_latest=args.changeover_latest,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        result = {"ok": False, "error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}
        print(canonical_json(result).decode("utf-8") if args.json else f"ERROR {result['error']}: {result['message']}")
        return 1
    if args.json:
        print(canonical_json(result).decode("utf-8"))
    else:
        summary = result["summary"]
        print(f"PASS {result['run_id']}")
        print(f"{summary['guide_module_count']} modules / {summary['delivery_project_count']} projects / {summary['permit_gate_count']} external gates HOLD / {summary['unsafe_site_release_count']} unsafe releases")
        print(CLAIM_BOUNDARY["claim"])
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def readdress_changeover_authority(latest_path: Path) -> None:
    latest = read_json(latest_path)
    old_run_dir = latest_path.parent / latest["run_path"]
    run_contract = read_json(old_run_dir / "run_contract.json")
    new_run_id = f"shared-floor-changeover-{sha256_value(run_contract)[:16]}"
    new_run_dir = old_run_dir.parent / new_run_id
    if new_run_dir != old_run_dir:
        old_run_dir.rename(new_run_dir)
    build_receipt_path = new_run_dir / "build_receipt.json"
    build_receipt = read_json(build_receipt_path)
    build_receipt["run_id"] = new_run_id
    build_receipt["artifact_sha256"] = {
        path.relative_to(new_run_dir).as_posix(): sha256_file(path)
        for path in sorted(new_run_dir.rglob("*.json"))
        if path != build_receipt_path
    }
    write_json(build_receipt_path, build_receipt)
    latest.update(
        {
            "run_id": new_run_id,
            "run_path": f"runs/{new_run_id}",
            "build_receipt_sha256": sha256_file(build_receipt_path),

class FakeEmbeddingProvider:
    def __init__(self, total_duration: int = 39000000) -> None:
        self.call_count = 0
        self.total_duration = total_duration

    def __call__(
        self,
        endpoint: str,
        model_name: str,
        inputs: Sequence[str],
        timeout: float,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        del endpoint, timeout
        self.call_count += 1
        if model_name != MODEL_NAME:
            raise AssertionError(f"unexpected model: {model_name}")
        fixtures = build_fixtures()
        expected_inputs = [item["descriptor"] for item in TOPOLOGY_SPECS] + [
            item["input_text"] for item in fixtures
        ]
        if list(inputs) != expected_inputs:
            raise AssertionError("runner changed the fixed batch input order")
        embeddings = [unit_vector(site_id) for site_id in TOPOLOGY_ORDER]
        embeddings.extend(
            unit_vector(EXPECTED_B_SITE_BY_FIXTURE[item["fixture_id"]])
            for item in fixtures
        )
        return {
            "embeddings": embeddings,
            "total_duration": self.total_duration,
            "load_duration": self.total_duration // 13,
            "prompt_eval_duration": self.total_duration * 35 // 39,
            "prompt_eval_count": 703,
        }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Embed per-page Noto Sans SC subsets into submission HTML pages.

The intake pipeline screenshots report/proposal*.html and visual/index*.html on
a host we do not control; without an embedded CJK face those screenshots can
degrade to box glyphs. Each page gets its own minimal woff2 subset (weights 400
and 700 instanced from the variable font), inlined as data URIs. Noto Sans SC
is licensed under the SIL OFL 1.1 (tools/fonts/Noto-CJK-LICENSE.txt).
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import base64, io, pathlib, re, sys
from fontTools import subset
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
from fontTools.varLib.instancer import instantiateVariableFont

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
VF = ROOT / "tools" / "fonts" / "NotoSansSC-VF.ttf"
FAMILY = "SF Noto Sans SC"
MARK = "/*sf-embedded-font*/"


def review_pages(package_root: pathlib.Path) -> list[pathlib.Path]:
    return [
        package_root / "visual" / "index.html",
        package_root / "visual" / "index.en.html",
        package_root / "report" / "proposal.html",
        package_root / "report" / "proposal.en.html",
    ]

def page_charset(text: str) -> str:
    chars = set(text)
    chars.update(chr(c) for c in range(0x20, 0x7F))
    chars.update("，。：；、！？（）《》「」『』【】——……·—‘’“”％℃±×")
    return "".join(sorted(c for c in chars if ord(c) >= 0x20))

def build_subset(chars: str, weight: int) -> bytes:
    font = TTFont(str(VF))
    instantiateVariableFont(font, {"wght": weight}, inplace=True)
    opts = subset.Options()
    opts.flavor = "woff2"
    opts.desubroutinize = True
    opts.drop_tables += ["FFTM"]
    opts.name_IDs = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    ss = subset.Subsetter(options=opts)
    ss.populate(text=chars)
    ss.subset(font)
    for rec in font["name"].names:
        if rec.nameID in (1, 4, 6):
            rec.string = FAMILY if rec.nameID != 6 else FAMILY.replace(" ", "")
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    font.save(buf)
    return buf.getvalue()

def css_block(w400: bytes, w700: bytes) -> str:
    def face(data: bytes, weight: int) -> str:
        b64 = base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")
        return ("@font-face{font-family:'%s';font-weight:%d;font-style:normal;"
                "font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,%s) format('woff2')}"
                % (FAMILY, weight, b64))
    return ("<style>" + MARK +
            "/* Noto Sans SC subset, SIL OFL 1.1 */" +
            face(w400, 400) + face(w700, 700) + "</style>")

def apply(page: pathlib.Path) -> None:
    text = page.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    text = re.sub(r"<style>" + re.escape(MARK) + r".*?</style>", "", text, flags=re.S)
    chars = page_charset(text)
    w400 = build_subset(chars, 400)
    w700 = build_subset(chars, 700)
    block = css_block(w400, w700)
    head_close = text.find("</head>")
    if head_close < 0:
        m = re.search(r"<style", text)
        head_close = m.start() if m else 0
    text = text[:head_close] + block + text[head_close:]
    # prepend the family to every font-family declaration that lacks it
    def add_family(m: re.Match) -> str:
        val = m.group(2)
        if FAMILY in val:
            return m.group(0)
        return f"{m.group(1)}'{FAMILY}',{val}"
    text = re.sub(r"(font-family:\s*)([^;}]+)", add_family, text)
    # `font:` shorthand resets font-family, so splice the family in there too
    def add_family_shorthand(m: re.Match) -> str:
        if FAMILY in m.group(0):
            return m.group(0)
        return f"{m.group(1)}'{FAMILY}',{m.group(2)}"
